primary_dataset: SurvFace-derived 96x96 gray crops; exploratory because K01-K05 appeared in v3 development
public_branch: frozen five-known K01-K05; no personal roster
secondary_dataset: Olivetti 40-way closed-set sanity; separate and never pooled with SurvFace

small_large_paired_final_error_correctio.interpretation: paired on identical public final crops by registered root; root variability is not person/session variability

v3_comparison.historical_control_interpretation: Exploratory only: all K01-K05 source images were in v3 development, which selected historical checkpoints.
v3_comparison.historical_encoders: v3 custom_base and custom_tiny remain non-face-pretrained historical representation controls; they were trained for a broad identity-verification task, not five-person identity classification.
v3_comparison.known_exposure: K01-K05 public identities appeared in v3 development, so v4 final results are exploratory and do not establish untouched external-person generalization.
v3_comparison.measured_improvement_claim: D adds a ten-root, target-supervised five-person classifier and embedding/gallery comparison with verified transfer initialization, role-gated open-set calibration, paired full-int8 inference, and a separate Olivetti sanity arm. A direct accuracy gain over v3 is only claimed where a same-crop, same-role historical prediction is audited and available.
